title: 第八章 翻篇
content_zh:
就在李火旺转身往回走的时候，他看到那位白化少女羞涩地褪下一只鞋子，从自己白皙到几乎透明的脚腕上摘下来一个缠着红线的金脚环。
睁大眼睛接了过来，李火旺把那金脚环放在自己手心颠了颠。这脚环虽然有些细，可这怎么说也是金的，估计能值不少钱。
他满意地把这些东西塞进道袍宽大的袖口后，用手指着那白发少女说道：“你们听着，以后料房归她管，什么事情都听她的。”
看到所有人迟疑的点头，李火旺提着备好的丹料向着丹房赶去。
他一边走着一边向着其他人的腰间偷瞄，企图寻找到另外一块玉佩。可惜他失望地发现自己并没有找到。
当李火旺重新来到丹房的时候，就看到那倍感压抑的丹炉缓缓
几颗暗蓝色的丹药随着丹阳子大袖一挥，迅速排列整齐进入了他腰间的土黄色葫芦。
这一手看的李火旺眼热不已，这应该就是玄阴口中所说的神通了，自己不知道能不能想办法学会。“搞钱还是我格局小了啊，如果能把这能力带到现实去，那......”
李火旺弯腰把手中的丹料放下，就准备站在一旁口观鼻鼻观心，现在自己还什么都不了解，还是多听多看。
“玄阳~”
“又来活了？这么快的吗？我还真成跑腿的了？也不能老跑腿啊，得想个办法让这癞子头把神通交给我才行。”
李火旺双手合拢对着喊话的丹阳子作揖。“师傅，您有什么吩咐？”
“去，把料房把一个叫白灵淼的药引带过来。”
李火旺的心咯噔了一下，作揖的右手伸进袖子里摸了摸那带着红线的脚环，白灵淼似乎是那白化病少女的名字啊。
“嗯~？”丹阳子扭头看向半天没反应的新弟子。
李火旺顿时感到一整牙疼，说真的，自己刚刚还说要罩着她呢，这马上就要回去说让她送死，这实在说不过去啊。
“我说的话你没听见吗？”
感觉到丹阳子的语气开始变得不善起来，李火旺无奈地叹了一口气闭上了眼睛。
等他再次睁开眼睛时，已经重新回到了洁白的病房内。“这可怎么办？”
如果在过去，他二话不说直接就照办了，可问题是那边的世界现在很有可能是真实的，自己如果真把人带去的话，恐怕就要真的杀人了，实在有些过不了心里那一关。

等护士们把自己放开后，李火旺咬着自己的拇指指甲，在房间内来回徘徊着。“怎么办呢？怎么办呢？”
没等想好办法，病房门被人从外面推开了，李火旺看到自己的主治医生从门外走了进来。
他顿时一阵苦笑，得，这下两边都堵上了，跑都没法跑了。
医生带着恨铁不成钢的表情用手指了指他，“你啊你，等探病家属离开，我们单聊。”
“探病家属？”
没等李火旺的反应过来，他就看到自己脸色憔悴的母亲行色匆匆领着橘子从外面的走了进来。
“我听说你跟人在医院里打架了？你头怎么了？怎么包成这样？疼不疼？”妇人冲上来，表情紧张地打量着。
“妈，不疼，我没事，我真的没事，有事的是他们。”李火旺连忙安抚到。
安抚了好一阵，李火旺总算是没有让自己母亲的眼泪没有掉下来。
在自己的至亲面前，无论那边的麻烦此刻都要向后放放了。
“你放心，我很好，我的病好多了，而且我的功课也没拉下，等出院就能参加高考了。”李火旺尽可能的报喜不报忧。
“别瞒了，医生都告诉我了，说说吧，那天到底发生了什么事情？是谁先动的手。”
李火旺用尽可能缓和的语气告诉自己的母亲，不过这似乎并没有缓和多少。
“我们占理的事情，赔什么钱赔钱!!是他们做的不对，哪怕就是有病，那也是医院的看护责任！我们家从来不欺负人，但是也绝对不能让别人欺负我们！有能耐打官司去！到了法院也是我们有理！！”激动的孙晓琴把桌子拍得砰砰直响。
看着一旁尴尬摸鼻子的医生，李火旺继续安抚。“妈，妈，别激动别激动，你好不容易来一趟就陪陪我吧。”
孙晓琴压制住自己心中的愤怒，弯腰把袋子里的水果拿出来。“这事你别管了，妈来处理，来，这是你喜欢的奶菩提，多吃点，你看你都瘦成什么样了，医院的伙食不好吧？”
“没有没有，医院伙食还是很不错的。”李火旺坐在母亲身边的吃了起来。
听着母亲的抱怨，吃着甜丝丝的萄提，李火旺得心静了下来。
他喜欢这种感觉，自从进入医院后他已经很久都没有体验到家人的温馨了。
看着自己的母亲，李火旺似乎张嘴就要把发生在自己身上的一切都说出来，可话到嘴边了，又放了回去。

不行，她跟杨娜不一样，自己如果说了，她只会认为自己的病情加重，不能再让她担心了，等一切稳定后再告诉她。
就在两母子聊得开心的时候，一旁的主治医师的手机响了，“孙女士，刘患者的家属也到了，您看.....”
“儿子，安心呆着，多吃点啊，吃完了我再给你买。”
孙晓琴和颜悦色的对着李火旺说完一挺胸，一转身如同一只即将决斗的公鸡向着门口走去。
不知道为什么，看到她离去的背影，李火旺就感到无比的安心。
母亲虽然强势，可只要呆在她身边，李火旺就感觉到很安心，她就像一把大伞罩在自己头顶给自己遮风挡雨，之前的一切麻烦引起的焦虑在这一刻都消失了。
“呵呵，待会大厅肯定很热闹。”李火旺又摘下一颗黄青的萄提放进自己的嘴里咬开，鲜甜的汁液在他口中炸开。
刚这么想的时候，李火旺身体猛地晃了一下，四周的一切重新开始变色。“哎呀，老妈过来让我忘记想该如何蒙混癞子头了，这下怎么办？”
当四周的一切重新稳定下来，李火旺就看到自己站在料房内了，丹阳子脸色不善地站在不远处。其他的药引把脑袋垂的低低的围成圈。
丹阳子污秽的右手一翻了，一团黏稠蠕动的黑色东西出现在他手中，每一次的扭动都发出癞蛤蟆舔舐眼珠子的声音。
“嗯？不是拿白灵淼炼丹吗？这是翻篇了？”
李火旺短暂犹豫一秒后就开口问道：“师傅，这是什么？”
“哼，好东西，太岁，黑太岁。”
content_en:
Just when Li Huowang turned around and walked back, he saw the albino girl shyly taking off one of her shoes and taking off a gold anklet wrapped with red thread from her almost transparent ankle.
Taking it with his eyes wide open, Li Huowang placed the gold anklet in his palm and shook it. Although this anklet is a bit thin, it is made of gold and is probably worth a lot of money.
After he stuffed these things into the wide sleeves of his robe with satisfaction, he pointed at the white-haired girl and said, "Listen, from now on, the cooking room will be under her control, and she will do everything she wants."
Seeing everyone nodding hesitantly, Li Huowang rushed towards the alchemy room with the prepared elixir ingredients.
As he walked, he peeked at other people's waists, trying to find another jade pendant. Unfortunately, he was disappointed to find that he had not found it.
When Li Huowang came to the alchemy room again, he saw the depressing alchemy furnace slowly
With the wave of Danyangzi's sleeves, several dark blue pills quickly lined up and entered the khaki gourd on his waist.
Li Huowang's eyes were filled with excitement when he saw this hand. This should be the magical power that Xuanyin mentioned. He didn't know if he could find a way to learn it. "My ability to make money is still too small. If I can bring this ability into reality, then..."
Li Huowang bent down and put down the elixir in his hand, and was about to stand aside and watch his mouth, nose and heart. He didn't understand anything yet, so he had better listen and read more.
"Xuan Yang~"
"Come back to life again? So fast? Have I really become an errand boy? I can't run errands all the time. I have to find a way to get this lewd man to give me his magical powers."
Li Huowang put his hands together and bowed to Danyangzi who was shouting. "Master, what are your orders?"
"Go and bring a Yao Yin named Bai Lingmiao from the material room."
Li Huowang's heart skipped a beat. He put his right hand into his sleeve and touched the anklet with red thread. Bai Lingmiao seemed to be the name of the albino girl.
"Huh~?" Danyangzi turned to look at the new disciple who didn't respond for a long time.
Li Huowang suddenly felt a toothache. To be honest, he had just said that he would protect her, but now he was about to go back and tell her to die. This was really unreasonable.
"Didn't you hear what I said?"
Feeling that Danyangzi's tone was beginning to turn unkind, Li Huowang sighed helplessly and closed his eyes.
When he opened his eyes again, he was back in the white ward. "What can I do?"
If in the past, he would have just complied without saying a word, but the problem is that the world over there is very likely to be real now. If he really takes people there, he may actually kill people. It is really hard to pass the test in his heart.
After the nurses let him go, Li Huowang bit his thumbnail and wandered back and forth in the room. "What should we do? What should we do?"
Before he could think of a solution, the ward door was pushed open from the outside, and Li Huowang saw his attending doctor walking in from the door.
He suddenly smiled bitterly, "Well, now both sides are blocked, and it's impossible to run."
The doctor pointed at him with a hateful expression, "You, you, let's talk privately after the visiting family members leave."
"Visiting family members?"
Before Li Huowang could react, he saw his haggard-looking mother hurriedly leading Orange in from outside.
"I heard that you had a fight with someone in the hospital? What happened to your head? Why is it wrapped like this? Does it hurt?" The woman rushed up and looked at her nervously.
"Mom, it doesn't hurt. I'm fine. I'm really fine. It's them who are in trouble." Li Huowang quickly comforted her.
After comforting her for a while, Li Huowang finally stopped his mother's tears from falling.
In front of his closest relatives, no matter what troubles there are, he has to put them aside at this moment.
"Don't worry, I'm fine. My illness is much better, and I haven't missed a beat in my homework., you can take the college entrance examination after you are discharged from the hospital. "Li Huowang reported good news and not bad news as much as possible.
"Don't hide it, the doctor told me, tell me, what happened that day? Who made the first move? "
Li Huowang told his mother in as gentle a tone as possible, but this didn't seem to ease her much.
"We have to pay for the things we take care of! They did something wrong. Even if they are sick, it is the hospital's responsibility to care! Our family has never bullied anyone, but we must never let others bully us! If you can afford to litigate, go to court! We were justified even when we got to the court! ! "Excited Sun Xiaoqin banged the table.
Looking at the doctor who was awkwardly touching his nose, Li Huowang continued to comfort him. "Mom, Mom, don't be excited, don't be excited, just stay with me after you finally come here. "
Sun Xiaoqin suppressed the anger in her heart and bent down to take out the fruit from the bag. "Don't worry about this matter. Mom will handle it. Come on, this is the milk bodhi you like. Eat more. Look at how thin you have become. The food in the hospital is not good, isn't it? "
"No, the hospital food is pretty good. "Li Huowang sat next to his mother and started eating.
Listening to his mother's complaints and eating the sweet grapes, Li Huowang felt calm.
He liked this feeling. He hadn't experienced the warmth of his family for a long time since entering the hospital.
Looking at his mother, Li Huowang seemed to open his mouth to tell everything that happened to him, but when the words reached his lips, he put them back.
No, she is different from Yang Na. If she tells her, she will only think that her condition has worsened and she can no longer worry about it. She will wait until everything is stable before telling her.
Just as the mother and son were chatting happily, the attending physician's cell phone rang, "Ms. Sun, patient Liu's family members are also here. Look..."
"Son, stay calm and eat more. I'll buy it for you when you're done. "
Sun Xiaoqin said to Li Huowang in a pleasant manner, puffed out her chest, turned around and walked toward the door like a rooster about to duel.
For some reason, Li Huowang felt extremely relieved when he saw her leaving.
Although his mother was strong, Li Huowang felt at ease as long as he stayed by her side. She was like a big umbrella covering his head to protect him from the wind and rain. All the anxiety caused by the previous troubles disappeared at this moment.
"Haha, the hall will definitely be very lively later. "Li Huowang picked another yellow-green grape and put it into his mouth and bit it. The sweet juice exploded in his mouth.
Just when he thought this, Li Huowang's body shook violently, and everything around him began to change color again. "Oh, mom came here and asked me to forget about how to fool the leprechaun. What should I do now? "
When everything around him stabilized again, Li Huowang saw himself standing in the material room, and Danyangzi stood not far away with an unkind expression. The other Yaoyin lowered their heads and formed a circle.
Danyangzi turned his dirty right hand over, and a sticky, wriggling black thing appeared in his hand. Every twist made the sound of a toad licking his eyeballs.
"Huh? Didn't you use Bai Lingmiao to make elixirs? Is this a reversal? "
Li Huowang hesitated for a second and then asked: "Master, what is this? "
"Huh, good stuff, Tai Sui, Hei Tai Sui. "
